text.formatted: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.
text.plain: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

text.formatted:
The drow's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- At will: Dancing Lights
- 1/day each: Darkness, Faerie Fire

text.formatted: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
text.plain: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

text.formatted: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also Unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
